name: graft
description: Graft — graft past code-review rewrites into the current change

scripts.build: npm run build -w @graft/shared && npm run build -w @graft/ingestion -w @graft/pipeline -w @graft/linking && npm run build -w @graft/compile && npm run build -w @graft/retrieval && npm run build -w @graft/mcp-server && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @graft/shared && npm run build -w @graft/ingestion -w @graft/pipeline -w @graft/linking && npm run build -w @graft/compile && npm run build -w @graft/retrieval && npm run build -w @graft/mcp-server && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
